description: Schedule a laundry pickup at a residential address. For any non-hotel address in the service area, including Airbnb and other vacation rentals (the rental address is the pickup address). Creates a guest customer account (no password needed — they can claim it later by signing up with the same email). Returns an order code (FOLD-XXXXX) and a Stripe payment-setup URL. The card is NOT charged until after intake. $39.99 order minimum applies. Only ZIPs served by Fold are accepted (see check_service_zip).

deliveryDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD delivery date. Defaults to pickup date + 1 day if omitted.

deliveryNotes.description: How to find / deliver to the address (gate code, doorman, leave at door, etc.).

deliveryWindow.description: Delivery time window label from check_service_zip.deliveryWindows. EVENING ONLY — Fold does not deliver in the morning. Defaults to the evening window if omitted.

idempotencyKey.description: OPTIONAL — pass a unique identifier (UUID recommended) to make this call safe to retry. If we have already seen this key, we return the EXISTING order code instead of creating a duplicate. Highly recommended for production agents that may retry on network errors.

line1.description: Street address line 1, e.g. "123 Main St"

notes.description: Optional special instructions about the laundry (e.g. "no fabric softener").

phone.description: Customer phone in E.164 format (+1XXXXXXXXXX) or US 10-digit

pickupDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date for pickup. Must be today or in the future.

pickupWindow.description: Pickup time window label from check_service_zip.pickupWindows, e.g. "9-11 AM".

zipCode.description: 5-digit ZIP. Must be in service area (use check_service_zip first).

name: book_residential_pickup
title: Book residential pickup
